title: AddGroupResult
description: Output of `group add` — the summary of the group added. The modified model is written back to the file (in place, or -o); --dry-run writes nothing.

added.description: the full name-path of the group that was added

repeatable.description: true if added as a repeatable group (--repeatable)

written.description: true if written to disk; false under --dry-run
